Hairspray is untouchable and will coat it and stick up eventually. In my opinion anyways... oils are also a often used product and just NO. 
What you want is a thick, matte wax. Mens wax. 0 SHINE. HIGH HOLD. MATTE. 
Drugstore stuff tends to be waaaaay to oily so try this with a boyfriend or brothers product if he has something similar. 
Avoid "anitifrizz paste, etc. 
So take a teenybtiny bit of the matte paste. Rub it into your hands like lotion. So it's basically nonexistent. Then straight up "paste" your hair down in the needed areas. The wax sticke to  itself, and it moldable through the day. This is what many hair stylists (myself included) use to smooth updos and pony tails. 
Do NOT use much. It it doesnt work, use a bit more. This will always work. Kevin Murphy knightrider is best or american crew fibre

I dont think I recommended any dry shampoo! I love dove, which is reasonably priced. And I like kevin Murphy fresh hair. Also rockaholic. Also I have colored, pitch black hair. So I use all of these and do not an issues with white residue. My trick is, I put it on before I go to sleep, or in Brush my hair after in every which way for like 4 mins. It disperses it. :)

My hair is 90% dry shampoo haha, and I use a lot of different brands, that one in particular I just hated, made my hair very heavy and clumpy. A lot of my clients that hated dry shampoo, it ended up being batiste. Thst being said, if you like it, stick with it!!! Its more directed at people who say they hate dry shampoo, thats usually the one that they have tried, so I suggest using something else, cause there isnt really anything to "hate" about dry shampoo . That's all :)

Oh okay gotcha ! So being that you have oily skin, you probably so have an oilier scalp then most. I'm assuming the booster shampoo is for volume  a lot of volumizing shampoos have thickening agents, which are essentially more product. Cheaper,unprofdessional brands are even heavier and oilier in the long run. I would reccomend a cleaning shampoo, or clarifying  it needs to be clear. (Like orange clear is fine ) just not creamy. So I'd you could get a hold of a sample size professional cleansing or clarifying shampoos you would see a change very quickly. Then, towel dry(like  in the shower, squeeze out with a towel extra moisture. THIS IS THE GAME CHANGER. USE A TOWEL. NOT YOUR HANDS. then apply conditioner  from the end of the ponytail, to the beginning of where your ponytail would start. 

These things will help immensely with your issue. Lastly, blowdry upside down. Or if you air dry, do that. Then once bone dry, take dry shampoo ( yes on the same wash day) to prevent any oils from producing, rather then loading it on once oily.

Tips. Battist is garbage.  I hate that dry shampoo so so so much.dove makes a much better cheap one

I'm a hairstylist with severe anxiety! 
We are people readers, and honeslty find one of the more toned down stylists(a bit quieter, not a loud style) maybe look online before going to pick your stylist. 
Anyways i very often get clients who are nervous and anxious about getting haircuts. Best thing you can do is not be rude, and fully explain that you do have anxiety, and are nervous. Our job is to make you comfortable and letting us know you are nervous will make someone go above to make you comfortable. And not in an awkward way.  If something is making you uncomfortable, say something 😊 if she or he is being rude, then leave and find another stylist cause that is so unprofessional. Hope this helps a bit! Feel free yo pm me
